auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Create a Demo or Pro API key in the CoinGecko Developer Dashboard: https://www.coingecko.com/en/developers/dashboard#api-keys. Select the matching plan below.

extraFields.label: API Plan
extraFields.description: Use demo for the free Demo API or pro for any paid API plan. The plan selects the API host and authentication header.

actions.name: get_coin
actions.description: Get coin metadata and optional market data, tickers and seven-day sparkline.

localization.description:
Include all localized languages in the response. 
Default: true

dex_pair_format.description:
Set to `symbol` to display DEX pair base and target as symbols. 
Default: `contract_address`

market_data.description: Market prices, capitalization, volume and other metrics.

additionalProperties.description: Localized description, potentially containing HTML.

outputSchema.description: Coin metadata and the requested optional data sections.

actions.name: get_coin_by_contract
actions.description: Resolve CoinGecko coin details and coin ID from an asset platform ID and token contract address.

detail_platforms.description: Platform contract addresses and decimal precision.

actions.name: get_coin_history
actions.description: Get a coin market snapshot at 00:00 UTC on a specified date, not that day's closing price. Demo history is limited to 365 days; paid historical access depends on plan.

date.description:

localization.description:

actions.name: get_coin_ohlc
actions.description: Get coin OHLC candles without volume. Timestamps are candle close times in UNIX milliseconds. Demo supports up to 365 days with automatic granularity; max and explicit hourly/daily intervals require paid access.

vs_currency.description:
Target currency of price data.

days.description: Data up to number of days ago.

items.description: Candle close timestamp in UNIX milliseconds, open, high, low and close.

outputSchema.description: Coin OHLC candles; timestamps represent candle close times.

actions.name: get_pool_ohlcv
actions.description: Get OHLCV candles for an explicit pool and token direction. Timestamps are UNIX seconds. Empty intervals are omitted unless requested. Each request covers at most six months; accessible history depends on plan and pool tracking. Second timeframes require eligible paid access.

network.description: GeckoTerminal network ID, such as eth. Use list_onchain_networks; this is not a CoinGecko asset platform ID.

aggregate.description:
Time period to aggregate each OHLCV. 
Available values (day): `1` 
Available values (hour): `1`, `4`, `12` 
Available values (minute): `1`, `5`, `15` 
Available values (second): `1`, `15`, `30` 
Default value: 1

before_timestamp.description: Return OHLCV data before this timestamp (integer seconds since epoch).

limit.description:
Number of OHLCV results to return, maximum 1000. 
Default value: 100

currency.description:
Return OHLCV in USD or quote token. 
Default: `usd`

token.description:
Return OHLCV for token, use this to invert the chart. 
Available values: `base`, `quote`, or token address. 
Default: `base`

include_empty_intervals.description:
Include empty intervals with no trade data. 
Default: `false`

items.description: UNIX seconds, open, high, low, close and volume.

ohlcv_list.description: Pool candles, retaining the upstream order and empty-interval behavior.

relationships.description: Related resource identifiers, such as tokens, pools, networks and DEXes.
Related resource identifiers, such as tokens, pools, networks and DEXes.

outputSchema.description: GeckoTerminal response with original related resources and metadata.

actions.name: get_prices
actions.description: Get current coin prices by ID, name or symbol, with optional market metrics. At least one selector is required; CoinGecko prioritizes IDs, then names, then symbols.

vs_currencies.description:
Target currency of coins, comma-separated if querying more than 1 currency. 
*refers to [`/simple/supported_vs_currencies`](/reference/simple-supported-currencies)

ids.description:
Coins' IDs, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin. 
*refers to [`/coins/list`](/reference/coins-list)

names.description: Coins' names, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin.

symbols.description: Coins' symbols, comma-separated if querying more than 1 coin.

include_tokens.description:
For `symbols` lookups, specify `all` to include all matching tokens. 
Default `top` returns top-ranked tokens by market cap or volume.

include_last_updated_at.description:
Include last updated price time as a UNIX timestamp. 
Default: false

precision.description: Decimal places for currency price value

anyOf.description: Quote currency prices and optional market metrics. Keys are currency IDs, metric suffixes and optional last_updated_at; values may be null when unavailable.

items.description: Quote currency prices and optional market metrics. Keys are currency IDs, metric suffixes and optional last_updated_at; values may be null when unavailable.

anyOf.description: Matching token quotes.

additionalProperties.description: One coin quote or multiple token quotes.

prices.description: Coin selectors mapped to quotes; include_tokens=all may return an array of token quotes for each symbol.

outputSchema.description: Prices keyed by the selected coin ID, name or symbol.

actions.name: get_token_prices
actions.description: Get global average prices and optional metrics for CoinGecko-listed tokens by asset platform and contract addresses. Supports up to 515 addresses per request.

asset_platform_id.description: CoinGecko asset platform ID, such as ethereum. Use list_asset_platforms; this is not an onchain network ID.

contract_addresses.description: Token contract addresses, comma-separated if querying more than 1 token

vs_currencies.description:
Target currency of coins, comma-separated if querying more than 1 currency. 
*refers to [`/simple/supported_vs_currencies`](/reference/simple-supported-currencies)

include_last_updated_at.description:
Include last updated price time as a UNIX timestamp. 
Default: false

precision.description: Decimal places for currency price value

additionalProperties.description: Currency price and metric map; unavailable metrics may be null.

prices.description: Contract addresses mapped to currency prices and optional metrics.

outputSchema.description: Global market prices for CoinGecko-listed tokens.

actions.name: get_trending

coins.description: Trending coins, each wrapped in an item field.
